authority: Read-only investigation and exact new evidence files only; no builds, installations, product edits, memory or canonical writes.
criteria: The baseline distinguishes pre-existing edits/failures, reader functionality and history; every candidate retirement caller is classified as runtime, shared helper, test, launcher, docs, distribution or historical.
Each process field/order claim has exact source support or an unexamined/absent classification; no canonical content is added to fill a demonstration gap.
The local-file 347-record inventory and complete 412-record loaded inventory retain their different scopes; a canonical process identity is a lead, not evidence of ordered process steps.
deliverable: Baseline, caller inventory and process evidence inventory plus raw named check logs.
objective: Capture the actual checkout, protected-file hashes/timestamps, current launch identity, relevant read/agent/Template results and all active workbench callers. Inventory selected canonical types, predicates, sources and supported process fields/order across linked sections. Inspect current initializer edition/resource callers and updater shipping exclusions, including publication intents/recovery state relevant to selected canonical inputs.
rationale: Bounded read-only baseline collection follows explicit inspected commands and inventories; it requires one accountable evidence worker, not alternative architectural solutions.
stop: All TASK-001 acceptance criteria have direct evidence or exact unavailable-check explanation.
